Our factory covers an area of below 1,000 square meters, supported by an office area of 501-1,000 square meters. We are certified to ISO 9001, and our products hold CE, RoHS, FCC and CB certificates. EPR registration for Germany and France (WEEE and packaging) is in place for European shipments.

We develop LED mirrors with lighting, touch and sensor control and anti-fog function, and we support custom sizes, frames, shapes, color temperatures and control options. OEM, ODM, custom design and buyer label services are offered, including private label printing, custom cartons and packaging, buyer barcodes and manuals.

Export and Service

Our foreign trade team of 11-20 people covers 11 languages, including English, Spanish, Japanese, German, Arabic, French, Russian and Portuguese, and our order preparation time is about 6 days. Exports are handled through our export agent, mainly to Southeast Asia, South America, North America, Eastern Asia, Africa and Eastern Europe.
